claims.text: POL-NS-01 requires all four limbs before a no-show amount is chargeable, and limb (d) fails outright here: it demands that the trip_record show the trip terminated by the driver with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT. EV-TRIP-00707 records status COMPLETED with cancelled_at, cancelled_by and cancellation_reason_code all null — there is no termination event and no reason code at all. On POL-NS-01's own closing sentence, where any of (a) to (d) fails the fee is not chargeable under that clause.

Limb (b) fails as well. It requires the gps_trace to place the driver inside the pickup geofence at or before the timestamp of the 'arrived' event, which EV-TRIP-00707 stamps at 2026-09-23T14:12:40+08:00. The gps_trace's first fix is 2026-09-23T14:12:50+08:00, ten seconds after that event, and the first qualifying in-geofence fix is the same 14:12:50 reading. No fix at or before the arrival event puts the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, so limb (b) is not met.

Even if the fee were otherwise live, the dwell is short. The driver's longest qualifying in-geofence run is 50 seconds against the 300 second STANDARD minimum, a shortfall of 250 seconds, and trip_record.wait_time_min of 1.0 corroborates a hold of about a minute, matching the driver's own statement that he arrived 'one minute before her'. Under POL-NS-06 the fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full where the effective dwell falls short of the minimum for the zone class, whether or not the rider was present.

The driver cannot make the difference up by accumulating separate intervals, because POL-NS-06(i) permits summation only where a present and populated traffic_advisory covering the pickup road carries a KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT type. The only advisory in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-00707-01, is MISSING — payload null, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight_multiplier 0.0 — and (i) is recorded as unavailable on that very ground. I cite that artifact for its absence, which is itself citable; it carries no content and no weight, so the 250 second shortfall stands.

Nothing on this record puts the rider away from the pickup. The gps_trace carries no rider track at all (rider_presence.available false, rider_fix_count 0), so POL-NS-04 limb (c) is UNDECIDABLE and, by the clause's own terms, neutral: the missing rider track is expressly not evidence that the rider was elsewhere and cannot be read against her.

No driver compensation can arise to be netted against the rider. POL-NS-07 pays 80 percent of the itemised cancellation fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and it is not satisfied here; the fee side is empty in any event, since EV-FARE-00707 itemises cancellation_fee 0.00 and its own derived money block reports fee_charged 0.00 and driver_compensation 0.00 against a schedule_fee of 4.00.

The sum the rider contests is carried in this category: EV-FARE-00707's derived money block records category NO_SHOW_CHARGE under policy_id POLICY-NO-SHOW for the 15.60 charged and still held (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). Because every condition this category places on a chargeable amount fails on the undisputed record, there is no basis within POLICY-NO-SHOW for retaining the contested amount, and the filing rider should have it returned in full.

There is no rider-side pattern that could justify withholding or treating this as abuse: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0, so neither POL-NS-09(d) nor POL-NS-09(c) is engaged, and those are the only profile fields the policy permits to be read for those two tests.

claims.text: The trip completed in the ordinary way, so no no-show event ever occurred. EV-TRIP-00707 records status COMPLETED, cancelled_at null, cancelled_by null and cancellation_reason_code null. POL-NS-01 limb (d) requires the trip to have been terminated by the driver with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT; none of those conditions is present, so the no-show fee framework the rider invokes never engages at all.

No cancellation fee was ever charged, so there is nothing for this category to refund. EV-FARE-00707 records cancellation_fee 0.00, refund_issued_sgd 0.00, and the ledger's own derived block reports fee_charged 0.00; the SGD 15.60 the rider contests is the metered fare for a completed trip (base 3.80 + distance 7.10 + time 3.90 + platform fee 0.80), not a no-show charge. POL-NS-06 authorises refund of 'the cancellation-fee line only, not any booking or platform fee that would have been charged on a completed trip', and POL-NS-01 fixes a chargeable fee only against a cancellation fee itemised in fare_breakdown.

The rider's stated grounds - an odour in the vehicle and no help with a suitcase - are service-quality complaints about a trip that was actually performed. No clause of POLICY-NO-SHOW licenses a refund of a completed-trip fare on those grounds: the category's refund clauses, POL-NS-03 through POL-NS-06, all operate on a cancellation fee, and this ride carried none. The rider is seeking the entire metered fare through a complaint channel that reaches only a cancellation-fee line.

The GPS trace confirms the driver reached the pickup point and the rider boarded. EV-GPS-00707 reports 6 qualifying in-geofence fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius - more than the 3 consecutive qualifying fixes POL-NS-02 requires - and the trip then started at 14:13:40 and ran 5.5 km to completion at 14:26:40. A ride that started and finished is not a driver no-show.

Because the ride completed and no cancellation fee was charged, the driver's counterparty statement - 'the ride completed normally; no cancellation fee was charged' - is corroborated by the trip record and the payment ledger rather than contradicted by them. There is no artifact that places the driver anywhere but at the pickup and no artifact recording any cancellation event.

Even the rider-favouring contact route is unavailable on this record. EV-CHAT-00707 contains zero messages, so there is no locating or coordinating message from the rider as POL-NS-04 limb (a) requires, and the clause could in any event only return a cancellation fee that was never charged.

The correct disposition is NO_ACTION. Under POL-GEN-03 no-action means the filing party's claim is not supported by the evidence and the present state stands - here fare_breakdown.payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00 are left exactly as they are, which leaves the metered fare the rider actually consumed in place.

Nothing on this record warrants escalation, so the dispute is decidable as it stands. The only counters POL-NS-09 may read show no pattern: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and the parties' respective disputes_with_counterparty_90d figures are both 0, so no POL-NS-09 trigger fires and the fee is not held for review.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: this complaint was filed through the no-show channel, but the record shows a completed trip, and the SGD 15.60 in dispute is the metered fare for that trip — not a no-show or cancellation charge. The rider's claim is not supported and the present state stands.

WHAT THE EVIDENCE SHOWS. EV-TRIP-00707 records status COMPLETED, accepted_at and arrived_at 2026-09-23T14:12:40, started_at 14:13:40, ended_at 14:26:40, with cancelled_at, cancelled_by and cancellation_reason_code all null. EV-GPS-00707 shows the vehicle covering the full 5.5 km route over that window (84 fixes, 100% coverage, no gaps). EV-FARE-00707 itemises the SGD 15.60 as base fare SGD 3.80 + distance fare SGD 7.10 + time fare SGD 3.90 + platform fee SGD 0.80 = SGD 15.60; its cancellation_fee line is SGD 0.00, refund_issued_sgd is SGD 0.00, and the ledger's own money block reports fee_charged SGD 0.00. The driver's statement ('the ride completed normally; no cancellation fee was charged') agrees with the instruments.

WHY THE NO-SHOW FRAMEWORK DECIDES NOTHING HERE. POL-NS-01 makes a cancellation fee chargeable only where all four limbs hold — limb (d) among them, requiring the trip to be terminated by the driver with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT. No such termination occurred. The rider advocate's points that limb (d) and limb (b) fail, and that the dwell is short (longest qualifying in-geofence run 50 s against the 300 s STANDARD minimum, shortfall 250 s), are correct as far as they go — but they concern a cancellation fee, and SGD 0.00 of cancellation fee was ever charged. POL-NS-02 through POL-NS-06 refund 'the cancellation-fee line only, not any booking or platform fee that would have been charged on a completed trip', so there is nothing within this category for them to return.

THE RIDER ADVOCATE'S STEP FROM THOSE FACTS TO A FULL REFUND IS REJECTED. The dispute's category label (NO_SHOW_CHARGE) does not convert a metered fare into a no-show fee; the fare breakdown's own cancellation-fee and fee_charged lines are SGD 0.00, and the SGD 15.60 is the price of a ride the rider actually took. The rider advocate's POL-NS-04 and POL-NS-07 points are accepted (no rider track, so limb (c) is undecidable and neutral; no compensation can arise on an unsatisfied POL-NS-01), but neither produces money in the rider's favour.

THE RIDER'S STATED GROUNDS. A smell in the vehicle and no help with a suitcase are service-quality complaints about a trip that was performed. No clause of POLICY-NO-SHOW licenses a refund of a completed-trip metered fare on those grounds. This ruling does not reach their merits; they remain open to the rider through the platform's service-quality channel.

OTHER POINTS. EV-ADVIS-00707-01 (traffic advisory) is MISSING, weight 0.00, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT; its absence decides nothing here because no fee was charged, and POL-NS-06(i) is recorded unavailable on that ground. POL-NS-05(ii) produces no false-arrival referral because six qualifying in-geofence fixes exist. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires (rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d 0; both parties' disputes_with_counterparty_90d 0; the anti-farming check at no_show_terminations_30d 1 of 110 completed trips does not trip), so the case is not escalated and the fee is not held. Under POL-GEN-03, NO_ACTION leaves payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd SGD 0.00 exactly as they are.

CONFIDENCE. The deciding facts — the trip completed and no cancellation fee was charged — are carried by EV-TRIP-00707, EV-FARE-00707 and EV-GPS-00707, each at weight 1.00, so the cap is 1.00; confidence is 0.95, above the 0.70 floor.

To both parties: this was a completed trip, not a no-show, and the SGD 15.60 in dispute is an ordinary metered fare, not a cancellation fee.

Rider — the trip record (EV-TRIP-00707) shows status COMPLETED, with cancelled_at, cancelled_by and cancellation_reason_code all null, and records an arrival at 14:12:40, a start at 14:13:40 and an end at 14:26:40 after 5.5 km. The fare breakdown (EV-FARE-00707) itemises the SGD 15.60 as base fare SGD 3.80 + distance fare SGD 7.10 + time fare SGD 3.90 + platform fee SGD 0.80, with cancellation_fee SGD 0.00 and refund_issued_sgd SGD 0.00. No no-show fee was ever charged. POL-NS-01 and the clauses around it decide only whether a cancellation fee is chargeable; they cannot return a metered fare for a trip you actually took, and this category gives no basis to refund one. The rider advocate's points are correct on the facts — limb (d) of POL-NS-01 fails outright (no termination event, no reason code), limb (b) is at best contested (the arrival marker is stamped 14:12:40, the first GPS fix is 14:12:50), the measured in-geofence dwell is 50 seconds against the 300-second STANDARD minimum (a 250-second shortfall), the rider track is absent so POL-NS-04 limb (c) is undecidable and neutral, and the chat log is empty — but every one of those points shows only that no no-show FEE was chargeable. None of them creates an entitlement to a different sum that was never a no-show fee. Your stated grounds, an odour in the vehicle and no help with your suitcase, are service-quality complaints about a ride that was performed; please raise them through the service-complaint channel, where they can be assessed on their own merits. The controlled amounts here (schedule_fee SGD 4.00 against fee_charged SGD 0.00, difference -SGD 4.00) simply confirm nothing was charged.

Driver — your statement that the ride completed normally and no cancellation fee was charged (submitted 2026-09-24) is corroborated by the trip record and the payment ledger. The GPS trace shows 6 qualifying in-geofence fixes and no false arrival marker is found, so no POL-NS-05(ii) record is entered against you, and because no no-show fee is chargeable no compensation arises under POL-NS-07.

On evidence weight: the deciding facts — that the trip completed and that no cancellation fee was charged — are carried by EV-TRIP-00707 and EV-FARE-00707, both at weight_multiplier 1.0 and independent of one another, so the confidence cap is 1.0. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00707-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT); its absence is noted but it carries no fact and is not needed for this outcome. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: no admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence; the profile counters those tests read are all zero or below threshold; and the deciding evidence is unimpaired.

Outcome: the filing party's claim is not supported by the evidence and the present state stands — the charged fare of SGD 15.60 remains in place (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00).

No cancellation (no-show) fee was ever levied. The no-show framework therefore never engaged: POL-NS-01 limb (d) requires the trip to have been terminated by the driver with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT, and none is present, and limb (b) is also unmet because the trace's first fix is 10 seconds after the arrival marker.

THE RIDER'S GROUNDS ARE OUTSIDE THIS CATEGORY. An odour in the vehicle and no help with a suitcase are service-quality complaints about a ride that was actually performed. No clause of POLICY-NO_SHOW licenses a refund of a completed-trip metered fare on those grounds — the category's refund routes (POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06) all operate on a cancellation-fee line and this trip carried none. The rider advocate's submission that the SGD 15.60 should be returned because the no-show conditions fail is rejected: those conditions decide whether a no-show fee is chargeable, not whether a fare for a completed trip may be retained. POL-NS-04's contact route is likewise moot: EV-CHAT-00707 holds zero messages, and because the trace carries no rider track, limb (c) is UNDECIDABLE and neutral under the clause's own terms rather than read against either party.

DRIVER COMPENSATION. POL-NS-07 pays 80% of an itemised cancellation fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full; it is not satisfied and there is no fee, so driver_compensation is SGD 0.00 on the ledger. The anti-farming check does not trip (driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d = 1, far below 4), and no POL-NS-09 trigger fires — rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d = 0 and both parties' disputes_with_counterparty_90d = 0 — so nothing is held for review.

CONFIDENCE AND WEIGHT. The deciding facts (trip completed; no cancellation fee charged) are carried by EV-TRIP-00707 and EV-FARE-00707, both at weight_multiplier 1.0, so the cap is 1.0. EV-ADVIS-00707-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT); it carries no fact and its absence is what makes POL-NS-06(i) accumulation unavailable, which changes nothing here.

OUTCOME. The rider's claim, as framed under the no-show category, is not supported by the evidence: the metered fare of SGD 15.60 stands as charged, and payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00 are left as they are. Open question for the parties, not a referral: if the rider wishes to pursue the service-quality complaint (vehicle condition, luggage assistance), it belongs in the appropriate service-complaint channel, not the no-show channel.

ruling.explanation:
This dispute was filed in the NO_SHOW_CHARGE category, and there is no no-show charge on this trip for anyone to refund or keep.

THE CENTRAL FACTS. EV-TRIP-00707 (weight 1.0) records the ride as COMPLETED — status COMPLETED, with cancelled_at, cancelled_by and cancellation_reason_code all null. EV-FARE-00707 (weight 1.0) records cancellation_fee 0.00 and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, with payment_status CHARGED. No cancellation fee was ever charged. Every condition POL-NS-01 places on a chargeable no-show fee, and every refund route in POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06, operates on a cancellation fee; with no cancellation fee there is nothing for those clauses to act on. POL-NS-06 itself confines any refund to 'the cancellation-fee line only, not any booking or platform fee that would have been charged on a completed trip.'

THE AMOUNT ACTUALLY IN ISSUE. The SGD 15.60 the rider contests is the metered fare for a ride that was performed: base_fare 3.80 + distance_fare 7.10 + time_fare 3.90 + platform_fee 0.80 = 15.60, matching quoted_fare_sgd 15.60 and total_charged 15.60. Nothing in POLICY-NO-SHOW licenses refunding a completed trip's metered fare, and the odour and luggage-assistance complaints are service-quality matters that no clause of this category reaches.

RIDER'S CLAIMS, ANSWERED. The rider's points are accepted so far as they go, and none of them moves the money. (i) POL-NS-01 limb (d) fails: EV-TRIP-00707 shows no driver termination event and no reason code. (ii) Limb (b) fails: the first GPS fix is 14:12:50, ten seconds after the 14:12:40 'arrived' event, so no fix at or before that event puts the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD radius. (iii) The in-geofence dwell is 50 seconds against the 300-second STANDARD minimum, a shortfall of 250 seconds, corroborated by wait_time_min 1.0. (iv) POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is unavailable because EV-ADVIS-00707-01 is MISSING (payload null, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0) — cited for its absence, which is itself citable, and carrying no weight. (v) The absent rider track makes POL-NS-04 limb (c) undecidable and neutral, not adverse to the rider. Each of these establishes only that no no-show fee is chargeable; none was charged, so they are immaterial. The further step the rider asks for — return of the whole 15.60 metered fare — is rejected, because that sum is fare for a completed trip and not a no-show charge. The rider's POL-NS-07 point (no driver compensation can arise where POL-NS-01 is unsatisfied) and POL-GEN-03 conclusion are answered together: no compensation arises, but the consequence is that the charge stands, not that the fare is refunded.

DRIVER'S CLAIMS, ANSWERED. Accepted. The completed trip and the zero cancellation fee are corroborated by both the trip record and the payment ledger, and the driver's statement — the ride completed normally and no cancellation fee was charged — is consistent with both. EV-GPS-00707 records 6 qualifying in-geofence fixes, and the trip started at 14:13:40 and ran 5.5 km to completion at 14:26:40.

CONFIDENCE AND ESCALATION. The deciding facts — that the trip completed and that no cancellation fee was charged — are carried by EV-TRIP-00707 and EV-FARE-00707, each at weight 1.0, so the cap is 1.0. Confidence is set at 0.90. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: confidence is above the 0.70 floor; no two admissible artifacts contradict each other; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and both disputes_with_counterparty_90d figures are 0 (POL-NS-09(c) and (d) not engaged); driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, well under the 4 threshold, and 1/110 is far below the 0.08 rate (POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip); and no impaired artifact is the sole support for a deciding fact. The case is therefore decidable as it stands.

OUTCOME. NO_ACTION: the rider's claim is not supported by the evidence, and fare_breakdown.payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00 stand as they are. No driver compensation and no referral are produced.

EV-TRIP-00707 records status COMPLETED with cancelled_at, cancelled_by and cancellation_reason_code all null — there is no termination event and no reason code at all. On POL-NS-01's own closing sentence, where any of (a) to (d) fails the fee is not chargeable under that clause.

Limb (b) fails as well. It requires the gps_trace to place the driver inside the pickup geofence at or before the timestamp of the 'arrived' event, which EV-TRIP-00707 stamps at 2026-09-23T14:12:40+08:00. The gps_trace's first fix is 2026-09-23T14:12:50+08:00, ten seconds after that event, and the first qualifying in-geofence fix is the same 14:12:50 reading. No fix at or before the arrival event puts the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, so limb (b) is not met.

Even if the fee were otherwise live, the dwell is short. The driver's longest qualifying in-geofence run is 50 seconds against the 300 second STANDARD minimum, a shortfall of 250 seconds, and trip_record.wait_time_min of 1.0 corroborates a hold of about a minute, matching the driver's own statement that he arrived 'one minute before her'. Under POL-NS-06 the fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full where the effective dwell falls short of the minimum for the zone class, whether or not the rider was present.

The driver cannot make the difference up by accumulating separate intervals, because POL-NS-06(i) permits summation only where a present and populated traffic_advisory covering the pickup road carries a KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT type. The only advisory in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-00707-01, is MISSING — payload null, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight_multiplier 0.0 — and (i) is recorded as unavailable on that very ground. I cite that artifact for its absence, which is itself citable; it carries no content and no weight, so the 250 second shortfall stands.

Nothing on this record puts the rider away from the pickup. The gps_trace carries no rider track at all (rider_presence.available false, rider_fix_count 0), so POL-NS-04 limb (c) is UNDECIDABLE and, by the clause's own terms, neutral: the missing rider track is expressly not evidence that the rider was elsewhere and cannot be read against her.
